svg.text: Ising chain: cooperativity from nearest-neighbor coupling
Lattice-gas form: weight x per bound site, extra factor ω per pair of adjacent bound sites
6 bound sites (x each), 3 adjacent bound pairs (ω each); empty sites weigh 1
Long chain: Z ≈ λ₊ᴺ, λ₊ the largest eigenvalue of T = [[1, x], [1, xω]]; θ = d ln λ₊ / d ln x.
